def factor_volume_breakout_ratio(df):
    """Volume breakout ratio comparing short-term maximum volume to long-term maximum volume."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    vol_short_max = df_copy["volume"].rolling(window=10, min_periods=10).max()
    vol_long_max = df_copy["volume"].rolling(window=50, min_periods=50).max()
    ratio = vol_short_max / vol_long_max.replace(0, np.nan)
    ratio = ratio.fillna(1.0)
    df_copy["factor_volume_breakout_ratio"] = ratio
    return df_copy["factor_volume_breakout_ratio"]
description: Ablation of parent factor_volume_breakout_price_location. Removes the price location modifier to isolate the core volume anomaly signal. Compares recent 10-day max volume to 50-day max volume; a high ratio indicates volume surges that may signal breakout. Preserves the economic mechanism of volume abnormality detection while simplifying interpretation.
